profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ NBCUniversal
profile.summary:
Developing software daily is a dream come true.

After my first Computer Science course I knew that I found my career path.  Solving puzzles and getting paid to do it? Why not!?

My favorite aspect of building software as a career is the progression that comes from tackling problems that at one point felt unsolvable, or beyond my capabilities.  This sense of progression is what motivates me to take on more difficult challenges.

Opportunity for growth and working with a driven, friendly, and talented team are what I will continue to value most in my career.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
React Engineer on NBC News Group Audiences team.

Building content on web to grow and support audience on CNBC, Today, MSNBC, NBC News, and Telemundo. Using React, Next.js, GraphQL, Jest, & Cypress.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mobile
positions.description: Mobile Engineer on automated scheduling application for healthcare workers.  This position was Full Stack and required development tasks on TypeScript React Native application, C# ASP.NET MVC backend, and MySQL database.

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description: Built cross-browser compatible Shopify themes for E-commerce merchants using traditional full stack web technologies with Liquid templating. Also developed React/Next.js Shopify applications.

positions.title: React Native Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Engineer on mobile peer-to-peer tool rental application. Managed application lifecycle from development to deployment into the App Store.

Developed user-facing components, deployed cloud functions on serverless backend, and maintained NoSQL database.

honors.title: NewsaPalooza Hackathon Winner
honors.description:
I was a part of the winning team for an internal hackathon for the NBC News Group. 

The prompt was allowing our brands to better connect with our users. 

I coded the demo.
honors.issuer: Issued by NBC News Group · Aug 2022

honors.title: Vicky L. Carwein and William B. Andrews Endowed Scholarship recipient.
honors.description: A scholarship I was awarded upon entrance into the Computer Science and Systems major by the University of Washington's School of Engineering and Technology.
honors.issuer: Issued by School of Engineering of Technology - University of Washington, Tacoma · Sep 2019

projects.title: Dark Despair Game
projects.description: A web mini-game I created using Javascript.

projects.title: ComChat
projects.description: An Android application built in TCSS450 at University of Washington, Tacoma.  This app is native Android and built in Java.  This was developed in an Agile group of four, the applications purpose was to allow real time chatting, connections with friends, and viewing weather data.  To accomplish this goal we leveraged Material Design, the Google Maps API, Heroku hosting, Express routing with Node, and a PostgreSQL database.
